items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: So Nick found out that I was in New York, and he sent for me, and I went down and talked to him, and he said, I'd like to have you put a band in my place.

ctx.x: And he used to talk to Nick a lot about me, see. So Nick found out that I was in New York, and he sent for me, and I went down and talked to him, and he said, I'd like to have you put a band in my place. So I said, I'd be happy to. He says, they never did have jazz here. All we had was piano players and singers, but I think that maybe we put a jazz band in here.
It might create something. It's a little tiny place. I hardly remember.
